{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Oonlanau''''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] that operated during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and it sometimes carried out freelance work for the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Renna (Rodian)|Renna]]. During the [[Confederation Rock Rush]] in c. [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] became caught in the [[Cularin asteroid belt]] due to the actions of a [[shadow creature]], which was draining passing starships of power.
